question_text: What is the context in which the data was created?
answer_summary: The dataset was created from a poll of real-world clinical questions frequently asked about structured EHR data. The questions were directly collected from respondents, while the SQL labels were created by the authors using the schemas of de-identified MIMIC-III and eICU databases. The source databases were further processed to prevent patient re-identification.

The dataset is based specifically on critical-care populations, which may limit representativeness.

Additional lower-level limitations include unnatural templated questions and restricted clinical variables.
